problem: GCS features that passed in simulation did nothing on the real drone: wrong lidar driver, readiness lidar rate stuck at 0 Hz, camera buttons closing detector gates, idle Abort failing the next flight, Set target ignored by the mission, stale mission state locking controls, QR without camera intrinsics, devices plugged in after boot invisible to the runtime, Mission Planner UDP receiving nothing after the laptop's DHCP address changed.
scope: Real-aircraft wiring between GCS, runtime, ROS nodes, devices and MAVLink router. Flight thresholds unchanged. mav_commander abort/start and execution_node terminal state are decision-adjacent changes covered by unit tests; no new flight run.

fixed_and_deployed.lidar_driver: mission2.launch.py lidar_model (default c1) -> sllidar_ros2 @460800 -> /scan_raw; see c1_lidar_driver_20261016.json
fixed_and_deployed.readiness_scan_qos: readiness_node /scan subscription now sensor-data QoS; live: 'Lidar rate: Ready'
fixed_and_deployed.camera_pose_names: camera_ctrl maps 0/-90/-45 deg to FORWARD/NADIR/ALIGN so detector gates open after GCS camera buttons
fixed_and_deployed.start_device_reason: execution_node names which device blocks a task (camera_actuator gate itself kept: unqualified feedback)
fixed_and_deployed.abort_latch: mav_commander clears an Abort older than 1 s at Start; one racing the Start stands
fixed_and_deployed.set_target: aggregator also publishes /mission/target_override, which the mission reads
fixed_and_deployed.terminal_mission_state: execution_node publishes COMPLETED/FAILED when a run ends (not for Outcome unknown)
fixed_and_deployed.qr_camera_info: qr reads /camera_info on the aircraft, /camera/camera_info in sim/gateway
fixed_and_deployed.image_frame: usb_cam frame_id camera_optical_frame (exists in URDF; camera_link did not)
fixed_and_deployed.hotplug_devices: run_container.sh web: cgroup rules c 188:* and c 81:* plus /dev bind; FC UART stays refused in the container
